title.zh: 修订第627号法，该法规定依《土地登记法》登记依法划作军事保留地范围内的所有土地，以及美国政府拟为军事用途购买的所有土地；本法通过删除其中的某个词语予以修订。原文在此处中断。
title.en: AN ACT AMENDING ACT NUMBERED SIX HUNDRED AND TWENTY-SEVEN, PROVIDING FOR THE REGISTRATION, UNDER THE PROVISIONS OF THE LAND REGISTRATION ACT, OF ALL LANDS LYING WITHIN THE BOUNDARIES LAWFULLY SET APART FOR MILITARY RESERVATIONS, AND ALL LANDS DESIRED TO BE PURCHASED BY THE GOVERNMENT OF THE UNITED STATES FOR MILITARY PURPOSES, BY STRIKING OUT THEREIN THE WORD
title.orig: AN ACT AMENDING ACT NUMBERED SIX HUNDRED AND TWENTY-SEVEN, PROVIDING FOR THE REGISTRATION, UNDER THE PROVISIONS OF THE LAND REGISTRATION ACT, OF ALL LANDS LYING WITHIN THE BOUNDARIES LAWFULLY SET APART FOR MILITARY RESERVATIONS, AND ALL LANDS DESIRED TO BE PURCHASED BY THE GOVERNMENT OF THE UNITED STATES FOR MILITARY PURPOSES, BY STRIKING OUT THEREIN THE WORD
title.vi: Luật sửa Đạo luật số 627 về đăng ký theo Luật Đăng ký đất đai đối với toàn bộ đất nằm trong ranh giới được dành hợp pháp làm khu quân sự và đất Chính phủ Hoa Kỳ dự định mua cho mục đích quân sự, bằng cách xóa một từ trong văn bản. Nguyên bản bị ngắt tại đây.
title.th: กฎหมายแก้ไขกฎหมายหมายเลข 627 ว่าด้วยการจดทะเบียนตามกฎหมายทะเบียนที่ดินสำหรับที่ดินทั้งหมดภายในเขตที่กำหนดโดยชอบด้วยกฎหมายเป็นเขตสงวนทางทหาร และที่ดินที่รัฐบาลสหรัฐฯ ประสงค์จะซื้อเพื่อวัตถุประสงค์ทางทหาร โดยลบคำหนึ่งคำออกจากข้อความ ต้นฉบับขาดหาย ณ จุดนี้
title.id: Undang-undang yang mengubah Undang-Undang Nomor 627 tentang pendaftaran menurut Undang-Undang Pendaftaran Tanah atas semua tanah dalam batas yang ditetapkan secara sah sebagai reservasi militer serta tanah yang hendak dibeli Pemerintah Amerika Serikat untuk keperluan militer, dengan menghapus satu kata dari teksnya. Naskah sumber terputus di sini.
title.ms: Akta meminda Akta No. 627 mengenai pendaftaran di bawah Akta Pendaftaran Tanah bagi semua tanah dalam sempadan yang ditetapkan secara sah sebagai kawasan simpanan tentera serta tanah yang hendak dibeli oleh Kerajaan Amerika Syarikat untuk tujuan ketenteraan, dengan memotong satu perkataan daripada teksnya. Teks sumber terputus di sini.

text.en:
Act Numbered Six hundred and twenty-seven, entitled "An Act to bring immediately under the
operation of the Land Registration Act all lands lying within the boundaries lawfully set part for military
reservation, and all lands desired to be purchased by the Government of the United States for military
purposes," is hereby amended by striking out the word "buildings" appearing in said Act as follows: In the
first and fifth lines of section one; in the tenth line of section two; in the sixth, tenth, and thirteenth lines of
section three; in the first and fifth lines of section four, and in the nineteenth, twenty-second, and twenty-fifth
lines of section seven.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, July 24, 1903.
